domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-03T12:02Z

Head-sha: `f8dab480177c2a43e48a4ad9f3bc223476c45025`

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, and `Fixes #29878` is the only closing keyword in the body. 4 files, +185 / −10. `check-governed-merges --pr 29917` reports NOT governed, at 195 lines, so this is an ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial in the body and the changeset, as in claim 6600797360. No contract review is owed: the change is app-shell internal, nothing is exported, and no locale key is added. The changeset is a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- **Serial:** PR #29883 landed first. The branch merged main once (a clean auto-merge on `appObjectScope.ts`), and every gate was re-run on the merged head.
- **File surface:** the claim's three files, plus `RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx`, which the seat approved before the edit. The PR body names it.
- **Read in the diff:**
  - Only the record arm with no declared record page passes `synthesizedRecordPage`. An assigned page has no history consumer (`pageColumnsEligible = !assignedPage`).
  - `sys_audit_log` is asked by name only when the route object declares `enable.trackHistory === true`, and never for `sys_audit_log` itself. It is asked through the same `views: false` scope as the lookup targets, in the same render, so the two reads go in parallel.
  - `ready` waits on the stream read (`routeReadDone`), so the first render's `fieldChanges` ask sees the object.
  - `routeOutcome` still reads only the route's own object. A refused, 404 or failed audit read keeps history off and draws the page. Nothing falls back to the registry.
- **Tests (dev, report 6603077215):**
  - 6 new harness cases. 4 are red at main's `appObjectScope.ts`, and the file passes 23/23. The 28737 plan-body case has a `false` CONTROL.
  - Ablation 1 (name dropped) reds 4. Ablation 2 (wait dropped) reds both first-render cases. Both were restored to the HEAD blob.
  - 59 affected files pass, 507/507. App-shell type-check is 65/65. All 35 derived gates exit 0, with 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- **Read cost:** one extra by-name metadata round trip, for tracked objects only, in parallel with the lookup read. Untracked objects ask nothing more (CONTROL). The live spec stays nightly, and the body says why.
- **Gates (check-runs on this head):** 44 success, 11 skipped (opt-in and schedule gates), 0 failed, 0 pending. Test UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check and Type Check UI all succeeded. `mergeable_state` is `clean`.
- **Accepted deviation:** the live showcase was not re-run. The harness reproduces QA's measure at `589049b0`.
- **Out of scope:** none reported. Nothing to file.
- **Landing:** `pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`. Merging closes #29878.
